definition: Revenue recognized by the reporting company and allocated to a named IP in its factsheet
platform_scope_rule: Use the publisher-defined product scope and record platform changes
comparability_rule: Comparable within a stable reporting definition; not consumer spending
forbidden_substitution: Do not relabel as gross billings or player spending

definition: NCSOFT title revenue shown within the mobile game chart before the 2026 royalty-integration change
platform_scope_rule: Mobile only as defined by NCSOFT
comparability_rule: Comparable only through 2025Q4 on the tested legacy scope
forbidden_substitution: Do not append royalty-integrated 2026 values to the same series

definition: NCSOFT IP revenue after royalties are integrated into IP lines
comparability_rule: Use a new metric version and never bridge the change silently
forbidden_substitution: Do not compare level changes across the scope break as organic growth

definition: Revenue reported for a publisher-defined IP across its editions and platforms
platform_scope_rule: Explicitly list PC console and mobile when the IP includes them
comparability_rule: Comparable within the IP definition; not a title-only or mobile-only amount
forbidden_substitution: Do not label as Black Desert Mobile revenue

definition: Official total company quarterly revenue multiplied by an official title share for the same period and denominator
platform_scope_rule: Inherits the official denominator's platform and region scope
comparability_rule: Retain the integer-share rounding interval and derivation formula
forbidden_substitution: Do not label the result OFFICIAL_REPORTED

definition: Revenue explicitly attributed to one named title by an official release
unit_examples: KRW million; KRW billion; JPY million; USD million
platform_scope_rule: Use the exact platform and region scope stated by the company
comparability_rule: Comparable only if recognition and consolidation scope are stable
forbidden_substitution: Do not substitute company or segment revenue

definition: Gross transaction amount before the reporting company's accounting recognition adjustments
Official growth percentage index chart or qualitative discussion without a verified exact franchise amount
platform_scope_rule: Record the stated geographic and platform context
comparability_rule: Context only unless exact labeled values and a stable denominator are available
forbidden_substitution: Do not infer exact values from chart geometry
